## Problem

The problem you are trying to solve, or the workflow that feels harder than it
should. "As an editor, I want to ... so that ...".

## Proposed solution

What you would like the plugin to do.

## Scope check

The plugin has deliberate non-goals (see `docs/PRD.md`). Please confirm your
request does not fall into one of these, or explain why it should be
reconsidered:

- [ ] It is not bulk or automated generation (the plugin does one action per
      explicit click).
- [ ] It is not a second provider integration or a provider abstraction layer.
- [ ] It is not image generation (images are read for alt text, never created).
- [ ] It is not a front-end / visitor-facing feature.
- [ ] It does not require the provider key to reach the browser.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you use today, or other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps explain the request.
